The floor manager noted a thought on kennel cleaning after reading your report, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk has reviewed the concern with care. You reported that your companion animal was left uneasy by the condition of the kennel and that the handling of the cabin area did not meet the standard you were promised. We acknowledge the distress this caused and understand why the experience felt unacceptable.

Our review indicates that the travel record should have reflected clearer pre-departure guidance and steadier in-flight oversight. The cabin team is expected to monitor animals with patience, keep kennels clean, and respond promptly to signs of discomfort. When that standard is not met, it is appropriate for us to record the issue, assess the service lapse, and strengthen supervision where needed. <<FACT F120>> The matter has been referred for follow-up so that the handling notes, cleaning checks, and crew briefing steps can be examined in full.

We also note your concern about the temperature conditions in the cabin and the effect this may have had on your animal's comfort. <<FACT F111>> In such cases, our role is to ensure the report is logged correctly, that the service review is completed, and that any corrective action is taken without delay. While no response can undo the inconvenience you experienced, Aurelia Skyways remains committed to dependable companion travel and to respectful treatment of every animal in our care.

Please accept our apology for the distress caused. Your report has been taken seriously, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk will continue to treat this matter as a priority. Clearer guidance, closer monitoring, and consistent kennel care are expected on every journey, and we regret that your experience did not reflect that standard. We appreciate the opportunity to review this complaint and to improve the service provided to future travelers.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
